qualification.abiCase: canonical MCP ABI accepts original selectors during refresh and after publication
qualification.method: Existing approved lifecycle fixture exposes the official SDK. Raw create/restore bypass Host admission guards only in this test to qualify Core behavior. One original selector and one original checkpoint are reused. Refresh is paused at tools/list with a fixture barrier.

phases.phase: tools/list failure published as unavailable catalog

qualification.sameSessionCase: canonical MCP catalog refresh restores the original Session without selection replacement
qualification.sameSessionResult: After TTL expiry, official Runtime activation restores actual echo RPC on the original Session and asks allow once again; no selection replacement or checkpoint restoration in that case.
interpretation: The SDK selection wire has selectors, not the Host catalog generation. This does not authorize arbitrary stale Host generations.
A background refresh need not fence valid existing authority. Host provenance, original deadline, and official Core refusal still apply.
A per-server refresh error can publish a replacement catalog withdrawing that server. Such a publication cannot be treated as an unchanged old catalog.
